title: The yes or no tarot spread
description: How to use a yes or no tarot spread: frame the question, read three cards as a case for, a case against and a tipping point, and keep the choice yours.

scenes.headline: The yes or no tarot spread
scenes.caption: The yes or no tarot spread uses three cards to weigh a decision rather than predict it. It sets out the case for, the case against, and what might tip the balance.
scenes.vo: The yes or no tarot spread uses three cards to weigh a decision rather than predict it. It sets out the case for, the case against, and what might tip the balance.

scenes.headline: What the cards can and can't answer
scenes.caption: Tarot has no way of knowing what will happen, so a card cannot tell you whether you will get the job or whether a plan will work out.
scenes.vo: What the cards can and can't answer. Tarot has no way of knowing what will happen, so a card cannot tell you whether you will get the job or whether a plan will work out.

scenes.caption: The case for yes, the case against, then what tips the balance.
